Alleged Secret Marriage Emerges in Pune Murder Investigation

An investigation into the murder of Ketan Agarwal in Pune has uncovered alleged evidence of a secret marriage between the victim, Chetan Choudhary, and Sia Goyal. Police are examining chat messages and documents for clues, with two friends reportedly acting as witnesses being questioned. The alleged marriage is said to have occurred four months prior to the murder.
